$description: Text and control colours with their own meaning, so fills and borders that share a hue keep the design's values. Light values meet WCAG 2.2 AA (D8); dark values are the design's.

link.$description: Ghost buttons and plain text actions. Light was the brand blue, 2.54:1 on the attention chip (D8)

link-hover.$description: Ghost buttons on hover. Light was the brand cyan, 1.75:1 on white (D8)

inverse.$description: Text on an inverted fill (fg.primary as the background): toasts and the style tooltip

track-off.$description: Track of an off switch. Light was white at 12%, invisible on white (WCAG 1.4.11, D8); dark keeps the design's value

panel.$description: Drop shadow of large floating panels (profile)
